before.title: regular 與 regularly
before.content: regular 是形容詞，修飾名詞；regularly 是副詞，修飾動詞。例：Regular exercise helps people sleep better, so Mia exercises regularly.

after.content: regular 在 regular exercise 中是修飾名詞的形容詞；regularly 是修飾動詞的副詞。regular 另可作名詞「常客」。例：Regular exercise helps people sleep better, so Mia exercises regularly.
